plotTwists: {user} leans in, but {target} turns at the last second and it lands on their cheek instead — somehow even sweeter.
{target} is so surprised they stumble back a step, and {user} catches them, and it becomes a whole moment.
A stray cat sits down to watch, visibly moved by the sincerity.
The moment is so wholesome that three random NPCs stop to say 'aww' in unison.
{user} gets so nervous mid-lean they trip slightly, and it somehow makes it even more charming.
The Whisper Merchant appears, genuinely touched, and gives {target} a flower out of pure emotion.
Time loops back and the moment happens twice, and it's just as sweet both times.
